understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to reach the gem tile marked + in each level, completing the current BP35 level and continuing until the game was won, while avoiding spike tiles.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was primarily horizontal with MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT, after which gravity automatically carried the player until landing or encountering an obstacle, hazard, or goal. Gravity direction determined whether the player fell toward smaller or larger y-values. CLICK removed targeted breakable or clickable tiles without moving the player, and UNDO could revert the previous action. Landing on spikes ended an attempt, while each level allowed two attempts with a limited number of turns.
